# Synthetic agent fixtures

Created 2026-11-12. No real transcript, identity, credential or user content was read or copied.

- plan.md: ordinary markdown, authored example for a shared preview, not recorded CLI output.
- codex-proposed-plan.txt: markdown/tag shape from Codex 0.167.1 embedded plan instructions, codex-evidence.md E2.
- claude-plan-approval.json: complete required object shape from Claude Code 2.1.322 embedded schema at binary byte 270487088 (read-only inspection). This is a teammate approval message, not an observed transcript envelope.
- codex-legacy-transcript.jsonl: deliberately minimal projection of the legacy session_meta.payload.id shape described by Codex 0.167.1 embedded guidance, codex-evidence.md E5. Not a full valid rollout record. No parser may treat this projection as a complete storage contract. Current paginated history is unresolved.

These exercise examples, not a promised vendor API. No vendor-history parser is recommended yet. Add complete source-backed transcript fixtures only when the current schema is established. Unknown fields must survive any future reader; vendor files must never be rewritten.
